connections.detailBody: Select a connection to see its details.
panel.title: About this page

dialog.title: Preferences

banner.note: Your app is ready to personalise.
footer.hint: You can change these choices at any time.
platform.explanation: PLUR1BUS will be available from the {place} when connected.
pair.name: Name
pair.once: Valid for one pairing. The code expires after about one hour.
pair.instructions: Get a code from Devices on your harness or run plur1bus device pair on its host. Certificates are verified before the code is sent.
pair.nativeInfo: The installed native CLI requests a code. Your local harness must be running.
connections.selected: Connection verified and selected. Opening the harness workspace will be available in the next desktop release.
connections.removeConfirm: Remove {name} and delete its sign-in from this device?
connections.interception: An unexpected certificate may indicate interception, including company TLS inspection. Verify the address with your administrator and pair again.
connections.caAdded: Company CA received through pairing. It applies only to this origin; no CA file is installed on this computer.
connections.trustNext: New certificate announced. Current and announced trust are accepted until the switch.
connections.memory: Sign-in: memory for this session only
pair.error.cli-missing: No running native harness was found. Start its OS service or use a pairing code.
pair.error.denied: The local account may not pair devices. Enter a code from an authorized harness user.
pair.error.insecure-origin: Use HTTPS, for example through tailscale serve. HTTP is allowed only for localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1], without a path.
pair.error.installation-mismatch: A different harness installation answers at this address. No sign-in was sent.
pair.error.incompatible: This harness API cannot create desktop sessions. Update the harness before pairing.
pair.error.trust-unavailable: The CA certificate is temporarily unavailable. Retry; your saved trust is unchanged.
pair.error.network: Could not reach the harness. Check the address and try again.
pair.error.revoked: This device was revoked. Its sign-in was deleted from the keychain. Pair again.
pair.error.keychain-memory-only: No keychain is available. Sign-in stays in memory only. After restart, remote connections need a new code; bundled connections pair again automatically.
pair.error.cert-changed: The certificate changed unexpectedly. No sign-in was sent. Verify the address, then pair again.
pair.error.ca-untrusted: Company CA not known or certificate invalid. Pair again to receive the correct CA from the harness.
pair.error.untrusted: The certificate is not trusted. Pair with a fresh code from the harness.
pair.error.proof-mismatch: The certificate proof does not match this code and address. The code was not sent. Obtain a new code from the harness.
pair.error.unauthorized: The code or sign-in is no longer valid. Pair again.
pair.error.protocol: The harness returned an unsupported response. Check its version.
pair.error.invalid: Check the entered name and code.
pair.error.storage: Connection details could not be saved. Try again.
pair.error.pairing-needed: This connection needs pairing before it can open.
connections.unchecked: Sign-in is checked when you open this connection.
pair.error.keychain-denied: Keychain access was denied. Allow access and pair again.
pair.error.keychain-unavailable: Credential storage is unavailable or locked. Unlock it and retry.
pair.error.keychain-error: Credential storage returned an unsupported response. Retry or check the OS credential store.
quit.title: Quit PLUR1BUS
quit.failed: Could not quit. Please try again.
autostart.label: Start PLUR1BUS at login
autostart.failed: Could not change autostart. Please try again.
autostart.unconfirmed: Autostart has not been confirmed in this session. Changing it requests permission.
background.hint: PLUR1BUS stays in the dash because no tray host is available. Close minimizes the window.
runtime.not-found: No local container runtime was found.
runtime.too-old: Update the container runtime before continuing.
runtime.no-access: Cannot access the runtime. Prefer rootless Docker or Podman; membership in the docker group grants root-equivalent access.
runtime.stopped: Start the container runtime and try again.
runtime.object-missing: The runtime object no longer exists.
runtime.conflict: An existing runtime object conflicts with this installation.
runtime.timeout: The runtime did not respond in time. Try again.
runtime.failed: The runtime operation failed. Check its local logs.
runtime.remote-endpoint-ignored: Remote Docker endpoints are ignored. Choose a local socket or named pipe.

wizard.installingBody: Preparing the image, persistent volumes, harness and local pairing.
runtime.nativeOnly: Runtime operations use the native desktop adapter.
wizard.error.cancelled: Installation cancelled. Your data volumes are retained.
wizard.error.image: The bundled image could not be verified or installed.
wizard.error.storage: The installation state could not be saved.
wizard.error.health: The harness did not become ready.
wizard.error.digest-mismatch: The bundled image could not be verified or installed.
wizard.error.disk-space: The installation state could not be saved.
wizard.error.pull-failed: The bundled image could not be verified or installed.
wizard.error.start-timeout: The harness did not become ready.
wizard.error.port-in-use: No free local port is available for the harness.
wizard.error.runtime-changed: The harness was installed with a different runtime.
wizard.error.invalid-resources: The resource settings for the harness are invalid.
wizard.error.not-installed: The harness installation was not found.
wizard.error.exec-failed: A setup command inside the harness failed.
wizard.licenceNotices: PLUR1BUS Desktop and the harness: MIT licence. Container runtime: its vendor licence. Model redistribution: the licence of the selected model.
host.empty: No feature needs a system permission yet
host.ready: PLUR1BUS Host is ready. No capabilities enabled.
host.unlock: Unlock secrets with the system keyring
host.statusHint: Secret-store status is unknown while the harness is stopped.
host.memoryOnly: Secrets stay locked. Install or unlock a Secret Service keyring to store the key safely.
host.failed: The action could not be completed. Try again.
approvals.title: Approvals
upgrade.wait: PLUR1BUS is unavailable during the update. Allow about 2–5 minutes.
upgrade.success: PLUR1BUS {to} is installed. The previous version and backup stay until the next update.
upgrade.rolled: The update to {to} failed at “{step}”. PLUR1BUS runs {from} with your pre-update data. This version will not be offered again.
upgrade.manualDone: PLUR1BUS runs {from} again. Your data is on the pre-update backup’s date.
upgrade.recovery: Recovery failed. Your backup and saved failed state are retained. Do not delete them; follow the recovery guide.
upgrade.copyFailed: Copy failed. Your details remain available.
upgrade.loss: Everything since {date} will be lost. Your current data is saved separately before restoring.
upgrade.operationFailed: Version or recovery operation failed. Open the recovery guide before trying again.
update.title: Update PLUR1BUS
update.security: Security update · offered again after seven days
update.storeManaged: Updates are managed by Microsoft Store.
update.channelManaged: Updates are managed by your installation channel.
update.policy: Checks at most every six hours. Automatic patches wait for quiet hours and an idle harness.
update.failed: Update check failed. Nothing was installed.
update.intermediateHint: This update cannot be installed until {version} is installed.
update.verify.failed: The update could not be verified. Nothing was installed.
update.verify.body: The signature or the integrity check did not pass, so this update is not installed. Installing it anyway is not offered.
crash.title: Previous app crash
crash.local: These details stay local. Nothing is uploaded.
ticket.title: Sign-in failed
ticket.detail: The single-use sign-in ticket could not be redeemed after one retry.
ticket.safe: Your runtime and data are untouched.
crash.openFailed: The diagnostics folder could not be opened.
crash.unclean: The previous app session did not exit cleanly.

installRuntime.title: Install a container runtime
installRuntime.guide: Install a supported runtime, then re-check. Existing containers and data stay in place.
installRuntime.failed: Installation could not finish. Check the runtime or the release package, then re-check. Placeholder packages cannot be installed.
installRuntime.linux: Install Podman or rootless Docker Engine using your distribution’s package manager. If Podman is installed, enable its user socket here.
installRuntime.macGuide: On macOS 15, install Docker Desktop, Podman Desktop, OrbStack or Colima yourself, then re-check. Review the vendor’s licence first. The bundled Apple runtime requires macOS 26 or newer.
installRuntime.dockerLicence: Docker Desktop uses Docker’s subscription terms. Free use has personal, education and small-business eligibility limits. Review the current vendor terms before downloading. The vendor installer asks you to accept its own licence.
installRuntime.podmanLicence: Podman Desktop is open source under Apache-2.0. Review the vendor’s notices before downloading. Its interactive installer presents the applicable terms.
installRuntime.appleLicence: The Apple container package is bundled with this app and uses Apache-2.0. No package download is needed. macOS Installer may request your administrator password. Apple’s tooling may download its kernel.
installRuntime.accept: I have reviewed the runtime licence notice
installRuntime.working: Installing runtime… Complete the vendor installer to continue.
advanced.cli: Install the bundled host CLI in your user bin directory.
advanced.path: Add CLI directory to my PATH
advanced.collision: An existing foreign plur1bus file is never overwritten. Resolve the collision before installing the app CLI.
advanced.done: Operation completed. Open a new terminal to use an updated PATH.
advanced.failed: Operation refused or failed. Check for an existing CLI or an unstaged release artifact. Your existing files are kept.
uninstall.title: Uninstall PLUR1BUS
uninstall.app_only: App only — keep images, data and keychain
uninstall.app_and_images: App and images — keep data and keychain
uninstall.keepsDefault: App only is selected by default. Your data is kept.
uninstall.keepsData: Data volumes, pre-update backups and keychain entries will be kept.
uninstall.removesData: This permanently removes your owned data volumes, backups and bundled-connection keychain entries.
uninstall.appRemoval: After cleanup, remove the app using your operating system’s uninstaller.
uninstall.shim: Owned CLI copy and its marked PATH entry
uninstall.keychain: Keychain entries for the bundled connection
uninstall.type: Type plur1bus-state to confirm permanent data removal
uninstall.complete: Cleanup completed. You can now remove the app.
uninstall.failed: Cleanup could not finish. Data is not removed without confirmation. Check the runtime and resolve any pending upgrade recovery before retrying.
uninstall.step.volumes: Selected data and backup volumes removed
uninstall.step.shim: Owned CLI copy and PATH marker removed
installRuntime.checksum: Installer checksum mismatch. Nothing was executed. Obtain an intact release package.
installRuntime.signature: Installer signature verification failed. Nothing was executed.
installRuntime.unconfigured: This preview has placeholder installer metadata. Install the runtime yourself or use a release with genuine verified artifacts.
installRuntime.collision: An existing file conflicts with installation. It was kept.
advanced.unconfigured: The bundled CLI has no genuine release checksum. This preview cannot install it.
advanced.checksum: The bundled CLI checksum does not match. No foreign CLI was replaced.
advanced.signature: Signature verification failed. Installation was refused.
integration.failed: The shortcut could not be changed. An existing foreign entry was kept.
integration.store: Windows manages Store startup in Settings → Apps → Startup. Disable PLUR1BUS there; your choice is preserved. Remove the desktop shortcut in File Explorer. In-app Store controls are not yet available.
advanced.sandboxed: Install the native host CLI separately. Flatpak cannot change the host CLI or your shell PATH.
transport.question: How do you reach this computer?
transport.tailscale.help: Both devices are in your tailnet.
transport.direct.help: Over your LAN, VPN or company network, using SSH or HTTPS.
transport.public.title: Public address
transport.public.remote: {host} points to an address on the public internet ({addresses}). The harness should never be reachable from the internet. Usually this is a typo, a wrong DNS record, or the harness was exposed to the internet by mistake.
transport.public.ssh: {host} points to an address on the public internet ({addresses}). SSH servers on the internet are attacked all the time. Make sure this is the computer you mean, and compare the host key on first contact.
transport.public.mixed: {host} has both private and public addresses, so the app treats it as public.
transport.public.confirm: I know this target is on the internet and want to connect directly anyway.
transport.public.changed: The address of {host} has changed and is now public. Confirm this before the app connects.
transport.special: {address} is a special-purpose address (for example for documentation or testing) and is not reachable on the internet.
transport.error.host-ipv4-noncanonical: Write the IPv4 address as a.b.c.d.
transport.error.host-invalid: This is neither a valid host name nor an IP address.
transport.public.session: This confirmation lasts only until you quit the app, because path settings cannot be saved right now.
transport.unresolved: {host} cannot be resolved. Are you on the right network or VPN?
transport.via-jump: {host} is resolved by the jump host and not checked here.
transport.tailscale.not-installed: Tailscale is not installed on this computer (tailscale.com/download).
transport.tailscale.check-unavailable.fl: The Flatpak version of the app cannot check Tailscale.
transport.tailscale.daemon-down: Tailscale is not running on this computer. Start the Tailscale app.
transport.tailscale.needs-login: Tailscale is not signed in. Sign in in the Tailscale app.
transport.tailscale.stopped: Tailscale is disconnected. Connect in the Tailscale app.
transport.tailscale.peer-unknown: {host} is not a device in your tailnet.
transport.tailscale.peer-unknown.cgnat: Internet providers also use addresses from 100.64.0.0/10 (carrier-grade NAT).
transport.tailscale.peer-offline: {peer} is in your tailnet but offline right now.
transport.tailscale.unreachable: {peer} is online but does not answer on port {port}.
transport.tailscale.route-mismatch: The connection to {host} does not go through Tailscale. Check subnet routes and other VPNs.
transport.tailscale.not-tailnet-target: {host} is not a Tailscale address. Choose “Direct” or enter the Tailscale name (for example computer.tailnet.ts.net).
transport.range.public: {range} contains public addresses (for example {example}). That is only right if your organisation owns public address blocks; otherwise it is probably a typo.
transport.store.newer: Path settings come from a newer app version and are left unchanged.
transport.tailscale.peer-online: {peer} is in your tailnet and online; the path was not checked.
pair.error.timeout: The harness took too long to answer. Your code may already have been used: check Connections first, then request a new code if the connection is missing.
runtime.logsFailed: The logs could not be loaded.
runtime.logsTimeout: The logs took too long to load.
update.installing: Installing the update… Keep the app open: it restarts when the update is ready.
